description: List every marketplace connected to this workspace with its setup state, health, last activity, any current sync error with `problem` (its kind, whether a person must reconnect the account, and what to do), orders revenue per currency, leads, product counts on the channel and how many imported products are waiting to be reviewed. advertising: true marks a channel where nothing is sold (Google Merchant), so its zero revenue is structural. Answers 'which channels do I sell on and is anything broken'. Takes no arguments. Use get_marketplace for one channel in detail, list_channel_products for what is on it, and check_channel_readiness for what it will refuse.
name: list_marketplaces
title: List marketplaces
